title: Human Remains Found in Niagara Falls
summary: Niagara police are looking for a killer after identifying human remains found in a demolished house in Niagara Falls. The remains were discovered in a house that was being demolished. The police have not released the identity of the victim or any details about the suspected killer. The investigation is ongoing. The house was located in Niagara Falls, and the police are reviewing evidence to determine the cause of death.
